description: A signed statement on whether a wallet is clear of sanctions lists, the same screen every payer here passes before a settle: the OFAC SDN address list and the on-chain sanctions oracle. Send an EVM address; get the result, both sources, the time of the screen, its expiry after 24 hours, the statement text and its signature from a ChainHelix key that holds no funds. A seller agent checks the signature and the expiry before it negotiates. clear: on neither list; listed: on at least one; partial: one source could not be read. Price: 6 cents per call.
name: screened_payer
